notes: Complete list: 28 actions (actions.js, one setActionDefinitions call) and 8 feedbacks (feedbacks.js, one setFeedbackDefinitions call). Nothing is generated per track or clip; the lists are filled at runtime.

Protocol: OSC over UDP to the AbletonOSC remote script of Ableton Live. Config fields (main.js getConfigFields): Target IP (default 127.0.0.1), Target Port (Send, default 11000), Receive Port (Listen, default 11001). Variables are not catalogued (variables.js plus runtime checkVariableDefinition calls).

The Clip, Track, Device and Parameter dropdowns are rebuilt by initActions() in main.js from the project scan (8 tracks and 8 scenes until a scan reports the real counts), so their choices are not enumerable offline; they are described with choicesNote, valueType and valuePattern. Clip and device ids are strings "<track>_<scene|device>", track ids are numbers, all 1-based.

The default of a dropdown is the first entry of the runtime list (or the fallback when the list is empty); the catalog records the fallback values (clip '1_1', track 1, device '1_1', parameter '0_0_0').

The source also sets minChoicesForSearch: 0 on the clip and parameter dropdowns; the schema has no field for it. The feedback clip_color declares affectedProperties: ['bgcolor'] and the boolean feedbacks have default styles; neither is recorded.
Value text inputs (Value 0-100, Step, Beat Position) have no regex and no useVariables; the callbacks parse them with parseFloat. Only the State field of fade_track_toggle has useVariables.
The module is on @companion-module/base ^2.1.2 (2.x), so option values may be expressions. This was not tested against a running Companion.
